scopedClaim: Within the supplied 28-candidate packet, these two coarse descriptors form seven numerically distinguishable groups at absolute tolerance 1e-12. Multiple candidate IDs share every descriptor group. Descriptor equality supports a local archive collision, not physical equivalence, independent replication, or global novelty.
preserved: The mean of reflection across the three sampled energies.
The magnitude of circulation at E=0, separating numerically zero values from finite magnitudes in this packet.
Seven distinct descriptor locations and their membership, conditional on the stated numerical tolerance.
informationLost: The circulation sign is discarded by the absolute value; opposite signed circulation, if present, would map to the same magnitude. The packet cannot establish which collisions are sign reversals.
The three individual reflection values, their energy dependence, order and spread are discarded by averaging; distinct profiles with the same mean could collide.
Circulation away from E=0, phase-sensitive response and other observables are absent.

Microscopic parameters, realization mechanism and physical identity cannot be reconstructed from these two numbers. Archive occupancy cannot establish material diversity or performance outside this toy.
uncertainty: Differences of order 1e-16 within groups are treated as numerical residue, not certified physical differences; no error bounds or convergence study are supplied.
The packet supplies neither signed circulation nor per-energy reflection, so no particular cause of a collision can be identified.

This is a three-site coherent scattering toy; no conclusion extends to Kagome structure, chemistry, stress, hysteresis, fabrication or experimental validation. Complex hopping still requires an implementation mechanism.
All observations share a deterministic simulator and curated pool. Separate packet access is procedural isolation, not an independent physical measurement or independent replication.

proposedTest.question: Do any candidate IDs sharing an archive descriptor differ in signed circulation at E=0 or in at least one of the three individual reflection values?
proposedTest.control: Recompute every same-group candidate with the same deterministic simulator, the identical three-energy grid, unchanged parameters and conventions, and a documented numerical tolerance. Repeat a reference candidate and use a tighter numerical setting to bound numerical drift. Record signed circulation and the ordered reflection triple before applying the current compression.
proposedTest.failureCriterion: The claim that each archive group is interchangeable for those resolved observables fails if any within-group pair differs in signed circulation or an individual reflection value by more than max(1e-10, ten times the measured repeat/convergence drift). If no pair differs, this test has not resolved the collisions; it does not establish equivalence under other observables.
